title: Asking for Directions
description: The learner is lost in a city and stops a passerby to ask how to get to a train station. The whole conversation is conducted in Japanese.
learner_role: a lost visitor asking for directions
objectives: Politely stop someone and explain you are lost
Ask how to get to the train station
possible_events: The directions involve multiple turns and the learner must ask for repetition
The passerby mentions the station is closed and suggests an alternative
success_criteria: Learner clearly states what they are looking for
Learner confirms or repeats back the directions given

difficulty_modifiers.description: Give one simple direction at a time, e.g. 'Turn left. Then stop.'
Give multi-step directions with landmarks in one breath
